newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears aid to GAN restructuring.
newsitem.headline: EU clears aid to GAN restructuring.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had cleared a French state capital injection of 2.8 billion French francs into GAN which is part of a plan to restructure and privatise the company.

The Commission said in a statement it had taken into account difficulties faced by GAN, a state-controlled financial group operating in both insurance and banking, in reorganising its banking businesses following heavy losses caused by the crisis in the French real estate market.
It also took into consideration the selling by the French insurer of some of its subsidiaries, particularly in the United States and Canada, and the sale of its majority holding in CIC.
The Commission said the French authorities had also committed themselves to privatising GAN aas soon after 1997 as market conditions allow.
